scope: Current native PDF-compatible VectorApple.ai CPU bottleneck investigation
profiler: macOS sample, eight seconds, 1 ms sampling interval

benchmark.cache: warm filesystem; process warm; no decoded image cache

observed: Dominant visible stacks are ShadingPattern::encode, sample_triangles, generate_patch_triangles and interpolation. Precise fill walk has only a small visible stack contribution. Recursive inclusive sample counts must not be added or treated as measured wall-clock percentages.
source_findings: generate_patch_triangles uses a fixed 20 by 20 point grid: 361 cells and 722 triangles per patch.
Colors are evaluated at four corners of every cell: 1444 interpolation calls for only 400 distinct unit-grid coordinates.
sample_triangles performs exact triangle/unit-pixel clipping over each transformed triangle bounding box.
Repeated corner evaluation is a concrete optimization candidate; bit-identical shading output and before/after timings remain required.
next_action: Reuse interpolation results at identical grid coordinates, preserving triangle order and exact values; qualify pixel identity and measure before/after without changing grid precision.
